name: OpenAI TTS
positioning: A model vendor whose audio speech endpoint turns text into spoken audio with a fixed set of built-in voices, alongside its language models.

compatibility.note: It is the origin of the request shape that other services copy.

strengths.claim: Uses one request shape across its models, which many tools already support
Lists several output formats including wav and flac

limitations.claim: The documentation describes a fixed set of built-in voices and no custom voice option

stepsToMove: Find every place your code calls the audio speech endpoint and note the model, voice and response format used.
Change the base URL and key in your client, since the request shape is the same.
Replace the built-in voice name with the voice id of the new service.

bestFor: Teams already on the vendor's platform that want speech through the same account and client library.
